title: Control 1
characteristics_ch1.1: tissue: Postmortem brain, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC)
extract_protocol_ch1.1: TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation v2 kit from Illumina.
description.1: RNAseq of Total RNA from 100mg of homogenate tissue.
data_processing.1: Alignment performed using TopHat (v2.0.4) to enforce strand specificity and to align the sequencing reads to known transcripts of the Ensembl Build GRCh37.67.
data_processing.2: FeatureCounts (v1.4.4) to count the total number of reads overlapping each gene using the default settings, with paired-end and reverse-stranded counting specified using the Ensembl Build GRCh37.67 gtf file.
data_processing.3: Counts were merged from both reads of the paired-end sequencing and normalized by library size and coding gene length to form Reads Per Kilobase of Gene per Million mapped reads (RPKM) values.
data_processing.4: RPKM values were transformed using log2 after applying an offset of 1 to each count.
data_processing.5: Normalized expression values were then filtered for genes with mean normalized expression values less than 0.5.
data_processing.7: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: log2RPKMcounts.xlsx: Excel file, normalized log2(RPKM +1) counts.
data_processing.8: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: log2RPKMcounts.rda: .rda format created in R, normalized log2(RPKM +1) counts.

data_processing.2: FeatureCounts (v1.4.4) to count the total number of reads overlapping each gene using the default settings, with paired-end and reverse-stranded counting specified using the Ensembl Build GRCh37.67 gtf file.
data_processing.3: Counts were merged from both reads of the paired-end sequencing and normalized by library size and coding gene length to form Reads Per Kilobase of Gene per Million mapped reads (RPKM) values.
data_processing.4: RPKM values were transformed using log2 after applying an offset of 1 to each count.
data_processing.5: Normalized expression values were then filtered for genes with mean normalized expression values less than 0.5.
data_processing.7: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: log2RPKMcounts.xlsx: Excel file, normalized log2(RPKM +1) counts.
data_processing.8: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: log2RPKMcounts.rda: .rda format created in R, normalized log2(RPKM +1) counts.
